definition.storageRationale: The full business and audited physical UPSERT key is (symbol, minute, event_type). trade_date is the Asia/Shanghai date of the source wall-time minute. Python materializes events from D087 minute bars using its amount-quantile/active-flow, OFI-depth-depletion, and cancel-ratio rules. Future return fields are look-ahead outcomes, not point-in-time features. Source Parquet wall time is explicitly localized to Asia/Shanghai and stored as a UTC instant; a later certified batch replaces all 73 values for the full event key.
